geolocation.helpIosSafari: How: tap the AA button at the top of the URL bar → Website Settings → Location → Allow. Or open iPhone Settings → Safari → Location → Allow.
geolocation.helpIosChrome: How: tap the padlock next to the URL → Site Settings → Location → Allow. Or ⋮ → Settings → Privacy → Clear Browsing Data (Site Settings) to reset, then try again.
geolocation.helpIosFirefox: How: ⋮ → Site Settings → Location → Allow. Or clear the site data from Firefox's Privacy menu and try again.
geolocation.helpIosEdge: How: tap ⋯ → Site Settings → Location → Allow, then reload the page.
geolocation.helpIosBrave: How: tap the lion icon (Brave Shields) → turn off temporarily, then try again. If it still fails: padlock → Site Settings → Location → Allow.
geolocation.helpAndroidChrome: How: tap the padlock next to the URL → Permissions → Location → Allow. Or ⋮ → Settings → Site Settings → Location → pick this site and switch to Allow.
geolocation.helpAndroidSamsung: How: tap ⋮ → Settings → Sites and downloads → Site Settings → Location → pick this site → Allow.
geolocation.helpAndroidFirefox: How: ⋮ → Settings → Site Permissions → Location → allow for this site.
geolocation.helpDesktopChrome: How: click the padlock next to the URL → Site Settings → Location → Allow, then reload the page.
geolocation.helpDesktopEdge: How: click the padlock → Permissions for this site → Location → Allow, then reload.
geolocation.helpDesktopFirefox: How: click the padlock next to the URL → remove the location block, then reload and pick Allow when prompted.
geolocation.helpDesktopSafari: How: Safari menu → Settings → Websites → Location → pick this site → Allow, then reload.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to questions we get often

items.q: Do I have to commit to 24 months like Qasir?
items.a: No. Komplit Monthly can be cancelled anytime, and Komplit Annual is just a 12-month commitment. We believe a good product doesn't need to lock customers into long contracts.

Yes — a permanent Free Tier (free forever) for Cost of Goods Sold, basic POS, and Inventory with unlimited SKUs. Want to try full Komplit features? We also offer a 30-day Komplit trial with no credit card required.

items.q: How many branches/outlets can I have?
items.a: The first outlet is included in the plan price. Each additional outlet is billed per outlet — Rp 540k/year for Komplit Annual, Rp 60k/month for Komplit Monthly. For 5+ outlets, contact sales for volume discounts.

items.q: Do I have to buy the Komplit plan?
items.a: No — we also sell individual modules. Only need POS? Pick POS Toko (Rp 49k/month annual). Only need Inventory? Pick Inventory Toko. But if your business needs 2+ modules, Komplit is ~40% cheaper.

items.q: How do I migrate from Qasir/Moka/Loyverse?
items.a: Contact the support team via WhatsApp. We'll help export data from the old system and import it into Vintra. Migration customers also get free 1-on-1 onboarding.
Currently manual bank transfer — our admin issues an invoice after confirmation via WhatsApp. No credit-card auto-charge. We're preparing Midtrans integration for auto-charge in a future update.
Not yet. The prices above are pre-tax — same as competitors like Qasir. 11% VAT will be added on the official invoice.

items.q: Can I upgrade from Toko to Komplit later?
items.a: Yes. Contact support — we'll prorate the price difference and issue an upgrade invoice. You don't need to cancel the old subscription first.

items.q: Is my data safe? What if I stop subscribing?
items.a: Your data stays on our servers for at least 6 months after your active period ends — reactivate anytime and your data comes back. Free Tier remains accessible indefinitely.

items.q: Is there an SLA or uptime guarantee?
items.a: For the Enterprise plan, yes — we provide a 99.5% uptime SLA + dedicated success manager. For Komplit, we also monitor 24/7 and average above 99.5% uptime, just without a formal SLA contract.

privacy.metaDescription: How Vintra collects, uses, and protects the data of our users in Indonesia.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

intro.heading: 1. Introduction
intro.p1: Vintra is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our platform.
intro.p2: By using Vintra, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

collected.heading: 2. Information We Collect
collected.lead: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services:

items.desc: your full name, email address, and phone number provided at registration.
business name, product data, ingredients, prices, and other operational information you enter into the Platform.
activity logs, pages visited, features used, and time spent in the service.
browser type, operating system, and IP address used to access the Platform.

usage.heading: 3. How We Use Information
usage.lead: The information we collect is used to:
items: Provide, operate, and improve the Vintra service.
Send account-related notifications such as registration confirmation, service updates, and subscription reminders.
Analyze usage patterns to improve features and user experience.
Communicate updates, offers, and other relevant information (you can unsubscribe at any time).
Detect and prevent fraud or misuse of the Platform.

storage.heading: 4. Data Storage & Security
storage.lead: We apply strict security measures to protect your data:
items: Data is stored on secure servers using Supabase infrastructure with enterprise-grade security standards.
Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest (encryption at rest).
Access to user data is restricted to authorized team members who need it for operational purposes.
We conduct periodic security audits to ensure optimal data protection.

sharing.heading: 5. Sharing Information with Third Parties
sharing.lead: Vintra does not sell users' personal data to third parties. We only share information under the following conditions:
items: With infrastructure service providers (such as hosting and analytics) that help us operate the Platform, as required for operations and under strict confidentiality obligations.
When required by law or a valid court order in Indonesia.
To protect the rights, property, or safety of Vintra, our users, or the public.

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies & Local Storage
cookies.lead: We use local storage technology transparently:

items.desc: used to keep your login session active securely.
used to store preferences such as theme and language.
We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

rights.heading: 7. User Rights
rights.lead: As a Vintra user, you have the following rights over your personal data:

items.desc: view personal data stored in your account.
update or correct inaccurate information through your profile settings.
delete your account and all associated data at any time.
download your business data in a readable format (CSV/Excel) via the export feature.

rights.contact: To exercise these rights or if you have questions, please contact <emaillink>support@vintra.my.id</emaillink>.

retention.heading: 8. Data Retention
items: Account and business data are retained while your account is active and you use Vintra.
After account deletion, your data will be permanently removed within 30 days.
Activity logs are retained for a maximum of 12 months for security and service improvement purposes.

children.heading: 9. Children's Protection
children.body: Vintra is intended for users aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 18. If you become aware that a child has provided personal information to us without parental consent, please contact us so we can remove it.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.lead: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time as our services evolve. If there are significant changes:
items: We will notify you via email or an in-Platform notice.
The "Effective from" date at the top of this page will be updated.
changes.reminder: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically so you stay informed about how we protect your information.

contact.heading: 11. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions, concerns, or requests about your privacy and data, please contact our team at: <emaillink>support@vintra.my.id</emaillink>. We're committed to responding to every privacy-related inquiry within 3 business days.
